title: S24b pile-up saturation timing frontier panel

split.bootstrap: 95% percentile intervals over held-out run blocks or endpoint source run folds

winner_scope: overall S24b timing and pile-up saturation frontier winner
winner_rationale: Gradient-boosted trees win the direct timing endpoint (sigma68_ns 1.126633 [0.834468, 1.406165]) and the two-pulse pile-up timing endpoint (time_rms_ns 6.995971 [6.800592, 7.179133]) while remaining competitive in saturated and multihit energy strata. Endpoint-specific exceptions are recorded: NN_1d_cnn wins saturation action-gate utility, geant4_birks_lookup wins inclusive energy and pile-up/multihit energy resolution, and physics_residual_mlp wins the saturated energy-onset stratum.
caveat: The ticket artifact is a focused S24b synthesis over already materialized raw-ROOT-derived run-heldout benchmark tables, with the raw ROOT reproduction gate copied into this ticket directory. It does not rerun every neural training job in this turn.
